thread.title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System • Tsuihou sareta Tensei Juukishi wa Game Chishiki de Musou suru - Episode 14 discussion

opinions.point: Many viewers were frustrated by repeated recaps, reused footage, and perceived time-padding.
Several commenters described the pacing as inconsistent or poor, with too little new material.
The game mechanics and setting remained appealing to some, but others felt the execution was undermined by padding.
Some viewers enjoyed the recent improvement in pacing compared with earlier episodes.
The voice performance for Ruche was repeatedly praised as especially energetic and entertaining.
Some viewers found the animation, visual filters, camera movement, and overall presentation unattractive.

notes: The title directly names the show and episode 14. The thread was retrievable through web search, and comments were paraphrased without plot spoilers. Community sentiment was predominantly negative about pacing and production presentation, with positive reactions to the setting, mechanics, and voice
